title: SIMSwapResponse
description: Properties related to the SIM Swap check for this transaction. This is only included if enabled by our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com).

swap_date.description: The date of the SIM swap, if one is detected.

swap_time.description: The time of the SIM swap, if one is detected.

risk_indicator.description:
Indicates the likelihood that a SIM swap occured for this number. The response ranges between `1` and `4`.
* `1` - **(very low)** Swap did not occur or it occurred 15+ days ago. 
* `2` - **(low)** Swap occurred between 3 and 14 days ago. 
* `3` - **(medium)** Swap occurred in the last 72 hours. 
* `4` - **(high)** Swap occurred in the last 24 hours.

status.description: Contains properties related to the status of the SIM Swap check.

code.description: A code indicating the status of your request.

description.description: Description of the status of your request.
